        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202610/3633603-20261020182537375-157741047.png" alt="[最优化技术] 3-7 坐标轮换法" class="desc_img">
        坐标轮换法每轮依次沿各坐标轴方向作一维搜索，把多维问题化为一系列一维问题，不需要梯度信息。文章以标准二元二次函数为例完整演算前两轮，给出 8 轮迭代表，收敛到 (3.992188, 1.996094)，并配程序框图、效能图与可运行 C++ 代码，最后分析该方法在斜置椭圆与脊线情形下的局限。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1><center>3-7 坐标轮换法</center></h1>
<h2 id="坐标轮换法">坐标轮换法</h2>
<h3 id="简述">简述</h3>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/h-elden/p/23260689" target="_blank">上一篇</a>介绍了修正牛顿法；本篇转向一种不需要梯度信息的直接搜索方法。坐标轮换法（Coordinate Descent Method），又称变量轮换法、交替法或降维法。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>与最速下降法类似，它也是一种迭代搜索方法。不同之处在于，最速下降法使用的是负梯度方向，而坐标轮换法直接使用<strong>坐标轴方向</strong>（基向量）作为搜索方向。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>该方法的基本思想是：每次只沿一个坐标轴方向进行一维搜索，找到该方向上的极小值点后，再切换到下一个坐标轴方向进行搜索。轮流沿各个坐标轴方向搜索，直到满足收敛条件。这种方法将多维问题转化为一系列的一维问题，因此也被称为“降维法”。</p>
<h3 id="原理">原理</h3>
<p>对于 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 元函数 <span class="math inline">\(f(X)\)</span>，其搜索方向取为坐标系的基向量 <span class="math inline">\(e_i\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[S_i^{(k)} = e_i = (0, \dots, 1, \dots, 0)^T \quad (1 \text{ 在第 } i \text{ 个位置})
\]</div><p></p><p>在一轮迭代中，算法依次沿 <span class="math inline">\(e_1, e_2, \dots, e_n\)</span> 方向进行 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 次一维搜索。第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 轮第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 次搜索的迭代式为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[X_i^{(k)} = X_{i-1}^{(k)} + \alpha_i^{(k)} S_i^{(k)}, \quad i=1,2,\dots,n
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha_i^{(k)}\)</span> 为沿 <span class="math inline">\(S_i^{(k)}\)</span> 方向作一维搜索得到的最优步长。</p>
<p>注意：坐标轮换法的搜索方向是固定的，<span class="math inline">\(S_i^{(k)}\)</span> 与迭代轮数 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 无关。</p>
<h3 id="具体步骤">具体步骤</h3>
<p>对于给定初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(0)}\)</span> 和收敛精度 <span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon\)</span>：</p>
<p>① 确定初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(0)}\)</span>，收敛精度 <span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon\)</span>，令轮数 <span class="math inline">\(k=1\)</span>；</p>
<p>② 取基向量作为搜索方向，<span class="math inline">\(S_i^{(k)} = e_i, \; i=1, 2, \dots, n\)</span>（对于二元函数 <span class="math inline">\(n=2\)</span>）；</p>
<p>③ 从当前点 <span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(k)}\)</span> 出发：</p>
<ul>
<li>沿 <span class="math inline">\(S_1^{(k)}\)</span> 方向进行一维搜索，得到点 <span class="math inline">\(X_1^{(k)}\)</span>；</li>
<li>从 <span class="math inline">\(X_1^{(k)}\)</span> 出发，沿 <span class="math inline">\(S_2^{(k)}\)</span> 方向进行一维搜索，得到点 <span class="math inline">\(X_2^{(k)}\)</span>；</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\dots\)</span></li>
<li>从 <span class="math inline">\(X_{n-1}^{(k)}\)</span> 出发，沿 <span class="math inline">\(S_n^{(k)}\)</span> 方向进行一维搜索，得到本轮终点 <span class="math inline">\(X_n^{(k)}\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<p>即：<span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(k)} \xrightarrow{S_1} X_1^{(k)} \xrightarrow{S_2} X_2^{(k)} \dots \xrightarrow{S_n} X_n^{(k)}\)</span>。</p>
<p>④ 收敛判断：若 <span class="math inline">\(\|X_n^{(k)} - X_0^{(k)}\| \le \varepsilon\)</span>，则结束，最优解为 <span class="math inline">\(X_n^{(k)}\)</span>；否则，令 <span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(k+1)} = X_n^{(k)}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(k=k+1\)</span>，重复步骤③。</p>
<p><strong>符号说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(X_i^{(k)}\)</span> 表示：在第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 轮迭代中，沿第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个坐标轴方向进行一维搜索后得到的点。它既是第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 次搜索的终点，也是第 <span class="math inline">\(i+1\)</span> 次搜索的起点。</li>
<li>对于 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 元函数，每 1 轮迭代都需要进行 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 次一维搜索。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="程序框图">程序框图</h3>
<div style="text-align: center">
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202610/3633603-20261020172749354-640067977.png" alt="坐标轮换法的程序框图" style="zoom: 55%">
</div>
<blockquote>
<p>符号说明：图中 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(d_i^k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\alpha_i^k\)</span> 分别对应正文的 <span class="math inline">\(X\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(S_i^{(k)}\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\alpha\)</span>；图中轮数从 <span class="math inline">\(k=0\)</span> 起算，判据为 <span class="math inline">\(&lt;\varepsilon\)</span>；正文从 <span class="math inline">\(k=1\)</span> 起算，判据为 <span class="math inline">\(\le\varepsilon\)</span>。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="实例计算">实例计算</h3>
<p>这里沿用之前的例子，演示前两轮迭代，并给出收敛过程。</p>
<h4 id="题目">题目</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(X) = x_1^2 + 2x_2^2 - 4x_1 - 2x_1 x_2,\;\; X^{(0)} = [1,1]^T,\;\varepsilon = 0.01
\]</div><p></p><p>记 <span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(1)} = X^{(0)}\)</span>。</p>
<h4 id="解答">解答</h4>
<p>为书写方便，下面把每次一维搜索中被优化的那个变量统一记为 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha\)</span>（它在该次搜索中就是自由坐标，不是上文的最优步长），对应的一元函数记为 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(\alpha)\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>第 1 轮迭代 (<span class="math inline">\(k=1\)</span>)：</strong></p>
<p>初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(1)} = [1, 1]^T\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>1) 沿 <span class="math inline">\(x_1\)</span> 轴方向搜索 (<span class="math inline">\(S_1 = [1, 0]^T\)</span>)：</strong></p>
<p>固定 <span class="math inline">\(x_2 = 1\)</span>，函数变为关于 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha\)</span> 的一元函数：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(\alpha) = f(\alpha, 1) = \alpha^2 + 2(1)^2 - 4\alpha - 2\alpha(1) = \alpha^2 - 6\alpha + 2
\]</div><p></p><p>求导令其为 0：<span class="math inline">\(\varphi'(\alpha) = 2\alpha - 6 = 0 \implies \alpha = 3\)</span>。<br>
得到新点 <span class="math inline">\(X_1^{(1)} = [3, 1]^T\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>2) 沿 <span class="math inline">\(x_2\)</span> 轴方向搜索 (<span class="math inline">\(S_2 = [0, 1]^T\)</span>)：</strong></p>
<p>从 <span class="math inline">\(X_1^{(1)} = [3, 1]^T\)</span> 出发，固定 <span class="math inline">\(x_1 = 3\)</span>，同样用 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha\)</span> 表示当前自由变量：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(\alpha) = f(3, \alpha) = 3^2 + 2\alpha^2 - 4(3) - 2(3)\alpha = 2\alpha^2 - 6\alpha - 3
\]</div><p></p><p>求导令其为 0：<span class="math inline">\(\varphi'(\alpha) = 4\alpha - 6 = 0 \implies \alpha = 1.5\)</span>。<br>
得到本轮终点 <span class="math inline">\(X_2^{(1)} = [3, 1.5]^T\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>3) 收敛判断：</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\|X_2^{(1)} - X_0^{(1)}\| = \|[3, 1.5]^T - [1, 1]^T\| = \|[2, 0.5]^T\| = \sqrt{4 + 0.25} \approx 2.06 &gt; \varepsilon
\]</div><p></p><p>不满足收敛条件，进入下一轮。</p>
<p><strong>第 2 轮迭代 (<span class="math inline">\(k=2\)</span>)：</strong></p>
<p>从 <span class="math inline">\(X_0^{(2)} = X_2^{(1)} = [3, 1.5]^T\)</span> 出发。</p>
<p><strong>1) 沿 <span class="math inline">\(x_1\)</span> 轴方向搜索 (<span class="math inline">\(S_1 = [1, 0]^T\)</span>)：</strong></p>
<p>固定 <span class="math inline">\(x_2 = 1.5\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(\alpha) = f(\alpha, 1.5) = \alpha^2 + 2(1.5)^2 - 4\alpha - 2\alpha(1.5) = \alpha^2 - 7\alpha + 4.5
\]</div><p></p><p>求导得 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi'(\alpha) = 2\alpha - 7 = 0 \implies \alpha = 3.5\)</span>，所以 <span class="math inline">\(X_1^{(2)} = [3.5, 1.5]^T\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>2) 沿 <span class="math inline">\(x_2\)</span> 轴方向搜索 (<span class="math inline">\(S_2 = [0, 1]^T\)</span>)：</strong></p>
<p>固定 <span class="math inline">\(x_1 = 3.5\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(\alpha) = f(3.5, \alpha) = 2\alpha^2 - 7\alpha - 1.75
\]</div><p></p><p>求导得 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi'(\alpha) = 4\alpha - 7 = 0 \implies \alpha = 1.75\)</span>，所以 <span class="math inline">\(X_2^{(2)} = [3.5, 1.75]^T\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>3) 收敛判断：</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\|X_2^{(2)} - X_0^{(2)}\| = \|[0.5, 0.25]^T\| = \sqrt{0.3125} \approx 0.56 &gt; \varepsilon
\]</div><p></p><p>仍不满足，继续迭代。</p>
<p>精确一维搜索下，各轮结果如下（第 1、2 轮的计算见上）：</p>
<table>

</table>
<p>第 8 轮位移 <span class="math inline">\(0.008735 \le \varepsilon\)</span>，停止迭代，得到</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[X^* \approx [3.992188,\ 1.996094]^T,\qquad f(X^*) \approx -7.999969
\]</div><p></p><p>已经很接近理论最优解 <span class="math inline">\([4,2]^T\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(f^*=-8\)</span>。</p>
<h3 id="方法分析">方法分析</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>方向简单，无需用梯度</strong>：外层搜索只需要函数值，不需要计算偏导数；一维搜索可用黄金分割法等只依赖函数值的方法，对导数难以求出的函数非常友好。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>多维问题效率较低，收敛慢</strong>：每次只改变一个变量，其他变量固定，搜索路径呈直角锯齿状。等值线为长短轴不平行于坐标轴的椭圆时，需要多轮迭代，效率显著降低，如图 4-21(b) 所示。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>特殊情况一轮到位</strong>：对于等高线为同心圆或长短轴与坐标轴平行的椭圆，即形如 <span class="math inline">\(F(X) = ax_1^2 + bx_2^2 + \text{线性项}\)</span> 的函数（变量之间无交叉项 <span class="math inline">\(x_1 x_2\)</span>），只需 1 轮迭代（<span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 次搜索）即可到达极值点；对二元函数就是两次一维搜索，如图 4-21(a) 所示。注意本节例题含 <span class="math inline">\(x_1 x_2\)</span> 交叉项，等值线是斜置椭圆，属于 (b) 的情况，所以需要多轮迭代。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>失效情况（脊线问题）</strong>：当等高线出现与坐标轴斜交的“脊线”时，沿坐标轴方向的搜索会停在脊线上，无法沿脊线方向继续前进，因而找不到最优点；这时需要进行转轴变换（坐标变换），如图 4-21(c) 所示。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<div style="text-align: center">
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202610/3633603-20261020172743576-687148367.jpg" alt="坐标轮换法的效能" style="zoom: 50%">
</div>
<h3 id="代码示例">代码示例</h3>
<p>下面只保留核心循环；函数定义、一维搜索子程序和输出见下方的完整程序。</p>
<details open="">
<summary>C++代码示例（坐标轮换法核心循环）：</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">// 核心循环：每轮依次沿 n 个坐标轴方向作一维搜索
for (int k = 0; k &lt; max_rounds; ++k) {
    vector&lt;double&gt; x_start = x;

    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
        vector&lt;double&gt; d(n, 0.0);
        d[i] = 1.0;

        auto phi = [&amp;](double alpha) {
            vector&lt;double&gt; new_x(x.size());
            for (size_t j = 0; j &lt; x.size(); ++j)
                new_x[j] = x[j] + alpha * d[j];
            return func(new_x);
        };

        // 省略异常处理，完整写法见下
        auto bracket = bracket_minimum(phi, 0.0, 0.1);
        double alpha_star = golden_section(phi, bracket.first, bracket.second, eps);

        for (size_t j = 0; j &lt; x.size(); ++j)
            x[j] += alpha_star * d[j];
    }

    double dist = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i)
        dist += (x[i] - x_start[i]) * (x[i] - x_start[i]);
    if (sqrt(dist) &lt;= eps) break;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h3 id="完整程序">完整程序</h3>
<details>
<summary>C++代码实现（完整）：</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;vector&gt;
#include &lt;cmath&gt;
#include &lt;functional&gt;
#include &lt;iomanip&gt;
#include &lt;utility&gt;

using namespace std;

// 进退法求初始区间 (复用)
pair&lt;double, double&gt; bracket_minimum(function&lt;double(double)&gt; func, double a0, double h) {
    const int MAX_ITER = 1e4;
    if (h &lt;= 0) throw invalid_argument("Step size h must be positive.");
    if (func(a0) &lt;= func(a0 + h)) {
        double x0 = a0 + h, x1 = a0;
        h *= 2;
        double x2 = x1 - h;
        int iter = 0;
        while (func(x2) &lt; func(x1)) {
            if (iter++ &gt; MAX_ITER) throw runtime_error("Max iterations exceeded");
            x0 = x1; x1 = x2; h *= 2; x2 = x1 - h;
        }
        return make_pair(x2, x0);
    } else {
        double x0 = a0;
        double x1 = a0 + h;
        h *= 2;
        double x2 = x1 + h;
        int iter = 0;
        while (func(x2) &lt; func(x1)) {
            if (iter++ &gt; MAX_ITER) throw runtime_error("Max iterations exceeded");
            x0 = x1; x1 = x2; h *= 2; x2 = x1 + h;
        }
        return make_pair(x0, x2);
    }
}

// 黄金分割法 (复用)
double golden_section(function&lt;double(double)&gt; func, double l, double r, double eps) {
    double a = l, b = r, aa, bb;
    while (b - a &gt; eps) {
        aa = b - 0.618 * (b - a);
        bb = a + 0.618 * (b - a);
        if (func(aa) &lt; func(bb)) b = bb;
        else a = aa;
    }
    return (a + b) / 2;
}

// 坐标轮换法
vector&lt;double&gt; coordinate_descent(
    function&lt;double(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; func,
    const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x0,
    double eps,
    int max_rounds = 1000
) {
    vector&lt;double&gt; x = x0;
    int n = x0.size();
    
    cout &lt;&lt; "\n迭代过程:" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "轮数\t点 X\t\t\t函数值 f(X)" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "--------------------------------------------------------" &lt;&lt; endl;

    for (int k = 0; k &lt; max_rounds; ++k) {
        vector&lt;double&gt; x_start = x;

        for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
            vector&lt;double&gt; d(n, 0.0);
            d[i] = 1.0;

            auto phi = [&amp;](double alpha) {
                vector&lt;double&gt; new_x(x.size());
                for (size_t j = 0; j &lt; x.size(); ++j) new_x[j] = x[j] + alpha * d[j];
                return func(new_x);
            };

            pair&lt;double, double&gt; bracket;
            try { bracket = bracket_minimum(phi, 0.0, 0.1); } 
            catch (...) { bracket = make_pair(0.0, 10.0); }

            double alpha_star = golden_section(phi, bracket.first, bracket.second, eps);

            for (size_t j = 0; j &lt; x.size(); ++j) x[j] += alpha_star * d[j];
        }

        cout &lt;&lt; k + 1 &lt;&lt; "\t";
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
            printf("%.6lf", x[i]);
            cout &lt;&lt; (i == x.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
        }
        printf("\t%.6lf\n", func(x));

        double dist = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) dist += (x[i] - x_start[i]) * (x[i] - x_start[i]);
        if (sqrt(dist) &lt;= eps) {
            cout &lt;&lt; "收敛！" &lt;&lt; endl;
            break;
        }
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    cout &lt;&lt; "坐标轮换法求解多元函数极小值" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "目标函数: f(X) = x1^2 + 2*x2^2 - 4*x1 - 2*x1*x2" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "理论最优解: X* = [4.0, 2.0]^T, f(X*) = -8.0" &lt;&lt; endl &lt;&lt; endl;

    auto f = [](vector&lt;double&gt; x) {
        return x[0] * x[0] + 2 * x[1] * x[1] - 4 * x[0] - 2 * x[0] * x[1];
    };

    vector&lt;double&gt; x0 = {1.0, 1.0};
    double eps = 0.01;

    vector&lt;double&gt; result = coordinate_descent(f, x0, eps);

    cout &lt;&lt; "\n最终结果:" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "最优解 X* = [";
    for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; result.size(); ++i) cout &lt;&lt; result[i] &lt;&lt; (i == result.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
    cout &lt;&lt; "]^T" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "目标函数值 f(X*) = " &lt;&lt; f(result) &lt;&lt; endl;

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>程序用黄金分割法（<span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon=0.01\)</span>）作一维搜索，实测第 1 轮为 <span class="math inline">\((3.002196,1.501746)\)</span>，与手算的 <span class="math inline">\((3,1.5)\)</span> 略有差异；第 8 轮收敛到 <span class="math inline">\((3.995681,1.997798)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(f=-7.999991\)</span>，末轮位移约 <span class="math inline">\(0.0097 \le 0.01\)</span>。差异来自一维搜索的精度。</p>
<h3 id="总结">总结</h3>
<p>坐标轮换法是一种最直接的降维优化方法。</p>
<p><strong>优点</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>原理极其简单，无需计算梯度。</li>
<li>每次一维搜索可达到给定精度；若用解析法，理论上可精确求解。</li>
<li>对于等值线为圆或长短轴平行于坐标轴的椭圆的问题，效率很高，两次搜索即可到达最优点。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>缺点</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>收敛速度通常较慢，且受等值线形状影响很大。</li>
<li>等值线为斜置椭圆时，需要多轮迭代，效率显著降低。</li>
<li>出现脊线时，搜索会停在脊线上，找不到最优点，需要转轴变换。</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>坐标轮换的逐维搜索思想也为后续方法提供了基础：鲍威尔法正是利用坐标轮换的原理构造搜索方向。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>下一篇将介绍<strong>共轭方向法</strong>。它从坐标轮换法和最速下降法出发，构造一组共轭方向，使二次函数最多 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 步收敛；再下一篇介绍<strong>共轭梯度法</strong>。</p>
<hr>
